jobs.content:
DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026: Apply for 219 Vacancies Across 24 Disciplines

Delhi Technological University | Advertisement No. 04/2026 | Application Deadline: 7 December 2026

Delhi Technological University (DTU), Delhi, formerly Delhi College of Engineering, has invited applications for 219 Assistant Professor positions across 24 disciplines through direct recruitment.

The recruitment includes backlog vacancies and a special drive for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Opportunities are available across engineering, applied sciences, management, economics, humanities, design, biotechnology and geospatial disciplines.

Online applications open on 23 October 2026 at 11:00 AM and close on 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Download the Official Advertisement | Visit DTU for Online Application and Recruitment Updates

Applicants must check the specific qualifications, relevant branches and other requirements for their chosen discipline. A broad subject match alone does not establish eligibility.

Eligibility Criteria and Salary

DTU directs candidates to the discipline-specific Recruitment Rules, referenced in Annexure II of the advertisement, for:

  • Essential educational qualifications.

  • Eligible and relevant branches or specialisations.

  • Experience requirements.

  • Pay scale and other appointment conditions.

The supplied 10-page PDF does not contain Annexures I and II. Applicants should obtain the applicable annexures and Recruitment Rules through the official DTU website or Recruitment Cell before applying. A uniform qualification or salary figure should therefore not be assumed for every discipline.

General Eligibility Conditions

Requirement

Details

Where no class/division is awarded, at least 60% aggregate marks is treated as equivalent to first class/division

Equivalent qualifications

Minimum eligibility

Fee concession or exemption applies only where the post is reserved for the respective category and the applicant applies against that reserved post, as stated in the advertisement.

  • Pay the fee online only.

  • Fees are non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against another recruitment.

  • A separate application and applicable fee are required for each discipline.

Selection Process

The recruitment involves academic screening, verification, a teaching presentation and an interview.

Stage 1: Initial Screening—100-Point Scale

Component

Maximum score

PhD

60

Relevant qualifying test/scholarship listed in the notification

The pre-PhD degree score is calculated using:

35 + 0.5 × (X − 50)

Here, X represents the percentage marks in the eligible pre-PhD degree. Candidates may select an eligible degree of at least two years’ duration, as specified in the Recruitment Rules, to maximise their score.

Stage 2: Consideration Zone and Detailed Scrutiny

DTU will publish a provisional consideration-zone list. Only candidates included in this zone will be required to send the signed application printout and supporting documents by the separately announced deadline.

The notification provides for provisional shortlisting of up to 4 + 8X candidates, where X is the number of advertised posts in the relevant discipline and category, subject to its tie-score and reservation provisions.

Stage 3: Document and Point-Mark Verification

Provisionally shortlisted candidates must produce original documents and self-attested copies supporting their qualifications, experience and claimed points.

Failure to produce the required documents may result in cancellation of candidature.

Stage 4: Teaching Presentation

Candidates who successfully complete verification will make a presentation assessing their teaching aptitude and ability.

Stage 5: Interview

The Selection Committee will assess domain knowledge and interview performance.

Final selection considers academic record, experience and research performance, teaching aptitude and ability, domain knowledge and interview performance.

Academic and Research Credentials: Separate 50-Point Framework

The application also requires information under a separate academic and research assessment framework. This is distinct from the 100-point initial screening scale.

Important Rules for Research and Experience Claims

  • Journal publication points are specified for SCI, SCIE and SSCI journals indexed in Clarivate Analytics. Applicants should not assume every indexed publication qualifies.

  • Eligible journal papers receive 3 points per paper for first, second, third or corresponding authorship, and 1 point per paper for other co-authorship, subject to the publication-category maximum.

  • Only work published online or offline by the application deadline is considered. Accepted but unpublished, under-review or submitted papers are excluded.

  • Guest-faculty experience is not counted.

  • Full-time PhD duration is excluded from research experience.

  • Experience is subject to the notification’s eligibility date, appointment type, minimum commitment and duration rules.

  • Every claim must be supported by evidence. Unsupported claims may receive zero points.

Reservation and PwBD Provisions

Reservation benefits apply under the relevant Government of NCT of Delhi rules.

Points Applicants Should Check Carefully

  • OBC reservation: The notification specifies OBC (NCL–Delhi) requirements and detailed acceptable certificate conditions. OBC applicants from outside Delhi should read these provisions carefully rather than assume eligibility for reservation.

  • EWS certificate: The required Income and Asset Certificate is for 2026–27, based on income for 2025–26.

  • OBC-NCL certificate: The applicable certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026, and no later than the application closing date.

  • Category certificates: Relevant certificates must be available by the application deadline.

  • Category changes: Requests to change category after submission will not be accepted.

  • PwBD reservation: Operates horizontally across applicable categories. Disability suitability must be checked against Annexure I.

How to Apply for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit DTU’s official website and locate Advertisement No. 04/2026.

  2. Read the detailed advertisement, relevant Recruitment Rules and annexures.

  3. Check your discipline, category, qualifications and supporting documents.

  4. Access the application link provided by DTU.

  5. Enter accurate academic, experience, research and category details.

  6. Upload the required documents and a clear recent photograph/signature.

  7. Pay the applicable fee online and retain proof.

  8. Review the complete application before submitting.

  9. Save the application number, submitted form and fee receipt.

  10. Monitor DTU’s website for consideration-zone notices and further instructions.

Only one application is permitted per candidate against a post. If applying to more than one discipline, submit a separate application for each.

Corrections or modifications—including category changes—will not be permitted after submission.

Documents to Keep Ready

Prepare relevant supporting records, including:

  • Educational certificates and mark sheets.

  • PhD award documentation and thesis front page.

  • Qualifying examination certificates.

  • Experience certificates.

  • Applicable category and PwBD certificates.

  • Publications and supporting authorship details.

  • Project sanction/completion documentation.

  • Patent acknowledgements or approval records.

  • Research-supervision evidence.

  • AIU equivalence documentation, where applicable.

  • Application fee receipt.

  • Clear photograph and signature.

Candidates employed in government departments, autonomous bodies or government universities must apply through the proper channel. Other employment-related certificates may also be required under the notification.

Hard-Copy Submission: Who Must Send Documents?

Hard copies are required only from candidates included in the consideration zone, when notified by DTU. The deadline will be announced separately.

Send the printed application, signed on every page, with self-attested supporting documents in a single sealed envelope to:

The Recruitment Cell
Room No. 818, 8th Floor, AB-3 Block
Delhi Technological University
Shahbad Daulatpur, Bawana Road
Delhi–110042, India

Mark the envelope:

“Application for the post of [Name of the Post] in the discipline of [Name of the Discipline]”

DTU will not be responsible for postal delays.

Important Instructions

  • Provide an active email address and mobile number.

  • Incomplete, late or unpaid applications may be rejected.

  • Candidates must appear in person for verification, presentation and interview.

  • Biometric verification will form part of the recruitment process.

  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the recruitment stages.

  • False information or unsupported eligibility claims may lead to cancellation.

  • Monitor DTU’s official website regularly for updates and corrigenda.

Official Links and Contact

Purpose

Link

Detailed advertisement-PDF

Download Advertisement No. 04/2026

Application access and recruitment updates

Visit DTU’s Official Website

Recruitment enquiries

recruitment@dtu.ac.in

A separate direct application URL and the annexure links could not be verified from the supplied PDF. Use the recruitment link published by DTU for this advertisement.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many Assistant Professor vacancies has DTU advertised?

DTU has announced 219 vacancies across 24 disciplines.

What is the last date to apply?

7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Is there an upper age limit?

The advertisement specifies no upper age limit for appointment as Assistant Professor. University superannuation norms apply.

Are Management and Economics positions available?

Yes. There are 10 Management (DSM) positions, 5 Humanities (Economics) positions and 1 Economics (USME) position.

Are the 17 PwBD positions additional to the total?

No. They are included within the 219 vacancies through horizontal reservation.

Must every applicant immediately send a hard copy?

No. Candidates included in the consideration zone must submit hard copies according to DTU’s subsequent instructions and deadline.

Can I change details after submitting?

No. The notification does not permit corrections or modifications after submission.

Where can I find the exact qualifications and salary?

Consult the discipline-specific Recruitment Rules referenced in Annexure II and available through DTU’s official recruitment information.

Review the official advertisement and applicable Recruitment Rules before submitting your application.

Download the Notification | Visit DTU for Application Updates

jobs.title: IIM Mumbai Faculty Recruitment 2026: Eligibility, Salary & Application
jobs.content:
IIM Mumbai Faculty Recruitment 2026: Rolling Advertisement for Management Faculty

Indian Institute of Management Mumbai has released a rolling faculty recruitment advertisement covering six management areas, with a focus on artificial intelligence, digital transformation and advanced analytics.

The notification provides eligibility and pay details for Associate Professor, Assistant Professor Grade-I and Assistant Professor Grade-II. Applications must be submitted by email in the prescribed format, and positions remain open until filled.

Recruitment at a glance

Particular

Details

Institution

Indian Institute of Management Mumbai

Advertisement number

Admn/Rectt/Faculty/2026/02

Advertisement date

13 October 2026

Location

Mumbai, Maharashtra

Positions detailed

Associate Professor; Assistant Professor Grade-I and Grade-II

Application mode

Email, using the prescribed application pro forma

Application deadline

Rolling advertisement: open until positions are filled

Application and enquiry email

admin.fa@iimmumbai.ac.in

About IIM Mumbai

IIM Mumbai, formerly NITIE, traces its establishment to 1963. The institute was ranked 6th in the Management category in NIRF 2025, as stated in the advertisement. Its Mumbai location supports engagement with industry through teaching, research, executive education and consultancy.

Academic areas

Applications are invited in the following broad areas:

  • Analytics & Decision Science

  • Economics & Strategy

  • Finance & Accounting

  • Marketing

  • Organisational Behaviour and Human Resources — OBHR

  • Digitisation in Supply Chain & Operations Management

Priority specialisations

The recruitment drive particularly emphasises:

  • Artificial intelligence: Agentic AI, machine learning and generative AI applications.

  • Digital transformation: Digitisation, digital commerce and ecosystems.

  • Analytics: Advanced data analytics, business intelligence and big data.

Candidates with demonstrated applications of AI, machine learning, operations research, simulation or advanced statistical modelling within their research domains will receive preference.

Eligibility and experience

The general qualification is a PhD in the relevant discipline, with First Class or equivalent at the preceding degree and an excellent academic record.

Position

Experience requirement

Preferable age limit

Associate Professor

At least six years of teaching, research or industrial experience, including at least three years as Assistant Professor Grade-I at an institution of repute; a successful research and publication record

45 years

Assistant Professor Grade-I

At least three years of teaching, research or industrial experience, excluding the PhD period

35 years

Assistant Professor Grade-II

Experience is desirable but not essential. Candidates who have completed their viva voce and received a provisional PhD award may also apply

35 years

The notification provides for consideration of relaxations in exceptional cases, including candidates with outstanding academic or industry experience in AI/ML and related areas. These are subject to the institute’s assessment.

Position clarification: The opening invitation specifically refers to Associate Professor, while the same notification includes eligibility and remuneration for Assistant Professor Grades I and II. Applicants seeking an Assistant Professor position may contact the institute for clarification.

Salary and academic pay levels

Position

Academic pay level

Advertised pay range

Advertised entry pay

Associate Professor

Level 13A2

₹1,39,600–₹2,11,300

₹1,39,600

Assistant Professor Grade-I

Level 12

₹1,01,500–₹1,67,400

₹1,01,500

Assistant Professor Grade-II

Level 10

₹57,700–₹98,200

₹84,700

Pay note: The Grade-II figures above are reproduced exactly from the advertisement. Candidates should confirm the applicable entry pay with IIM Mumbai.

Allowances and benefits are governed by institute and Government of India rules.

Research expectations

Applicants should demonstrate strong research potential, teaching capability and a commitment to postgraduate education.

The advertisement highlights:

  • Publications in peer-reviewed Web of Science Q1/Q2 journals.

  • Preference for highly regarded journals, including FT50 journals.

  • Weightage for Q1 publications where the applicant is the first or corresponding author.

  • Submission of the applicant’s three best Web of Science Q1/Q2 papers.

  • Publication details including journal impact factors, publication years and authorship information.

  • Evidence of academic leadership, original research and industry engagement.

Applicants who applied during the previous two years should highlight substantial improvements in their CV.

Research support and faculty benefits

Subject to institute norms, the advertisement lists:

  • Research seed grant of up to ₹15 lakh.

  • Cumulative Professional Development Allowance of ₹3 lakh per three-year block.

  • Support for national and international conference participation.

  • Accommodation-related benefits, DA and HRA as applicable.

  • Medical insurance, LTC, children’s education allowance and pension contributions.

  • Consultancy opportunities, with institutional consultancy and professional activities permitted for up to 52 days annually under applicable rules.

How to apply

  1. Read the official advertisement and download the prescribed application pro forma.

  2. Complete the application and prepare it in both PDF and Word formats.

  3. Attach the required supporting documents, including:

    • Photograph.

    • Educational certificates and proof of the PhD defence date.

    • Experience certificates stating designation, pay and tenure.

    • Applicable valid category certificates.

    • Publication information and copies of the three best papers.

  4. Email the application and supporting documents to admin.fa@iimmumbai.ac.in.

  5. Submit a separate application for each academic area if applying in more than one area.

Applicants employed in government organisations or educational institutions must apply through the proper channel or provide an NOC at the stage specified in the notification. Applicants working with foreign organisations or educational institutions are exempted from this requirement.

Deadline: No fixed closing date is specified. Applications will be screened according to institutional requirements until positions are filled.

Selection process

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a presentation followed by a personal interview. The institute may conduct the process in person or online.

Meeting the minimum eligibility requirements does not guarantee shortlisting. Regular appointments carry a two-year probation period; contractual appointments may also be considered.

Government of India reservation rules apply. Qualified women and candidates from reserved categories are encouraged to apply.

Official notification, application form and contact

  • Download the official recruitment advertisement

  • Download the faculty application pro forma

  • Visit the IIM Mumbai careers page

  • Visit the IIM Mumbai website

  • Application and enquiries: admin.fa@iimmumbai.ac.in

Applicants should check the official careers page for amendments and updates before submitting their application.

jobs.title: Faculty Recruitment 2026 at IMI Bhubaneswar – Assistant Professor, Associate Professor & Professor
jobs.content:
Faculty Recruitment 2026 at IMI Bhubaneswar – Assistant Professor, Associate Professor & Professor

International Management Institute (IMI) Bhubaneswar invites applications from qualified academicians and researchers for regular faculty positions at all levels, including Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, and Professor.

The institute seeks candidates demonstrating excellence in teaching, research, academic leadership, and industry engagement.

Position Overview

Particulars

Details

Institution

International Management Institute (IMI) Bhubaneswar

Recruitment Type

Regular Faculty Recruitment

Positions

Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor

Employment Type

Regular Faculty

Location

Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India

Minimum Qualification

PhD/FPM in a relevant field

Selection Criteria

Academic qualifications, publications, teaching, research, and experience

Application Mode

Email

About the Opportunity

IMI Bhubaneswar is recruiting faculty members across academic ranks to strengthen its teaching, research, consulting, and institutional development activities.

Candidates with strong academic credentials, research publications, teaching capabilities, and demonstrated potential for academic leadership are encouraged to apply.

1. Assistant Professor

Essential Qualification

  • PhD/FPM in a relevant discipline.

  • Thesis-submitted candidates from leading institutions may also be considered.

  • Minimum 2 peer-reviewed publications, including at least 1 publication in a Tier 1–3 journal.

  • Candidates with exceptional job-market papers or doctoral theses may be considered through the high-potential route.

Preferred Academic Profile

  • Strong research potential and publication capabilities.

  • Commitment to teaching excellence.

  • Ability to contribute to academic programmes and research activities.

2. Associate Professor

Essential Qualification

  • PhD/FPM in a relevant discipline.

  • Minimum 7 research publications, including 3 or more in Tier 1–3 journals.

Experience Required

- Minimum 8 years of total experience, including 5 years of post-PhD experience.

OR

- 5 years at the Assistant Professor/Associate Professor level at an international institution, IIM, IIT, or NIRF Top 50 institution.

Preferred Academic Profile

  • Established research publication record.

  • Experience in postgraduate management education.

  • Academic mentoring and institutional contributions.

3. Professor

Essential Qualification

  • PhD/FPM in a relevant discipline.

  • Minimum 15 research publications, including 6 or more in Tier 1–3 journals.

  • After becoming Associate Professor, at least 6 publications and guidance of 2 PhD scholars.

Experience Required

- Minimum 10 years of academic experience, including 5 years at the Associate Professor/Professor level.

Preferred Academic Profile

  • Strong research and teaching record.

  • Experience in doctoral supervision.

  • Academic leadership and institutional development capabilities.

Key Competencies

IMI Bhubaneswar seeks faculty members with demonstrated capabilities in:

  • Teaching Excellence: Delivering high-quality management education.

  • Research Capability: Publishing impactful research in recognized academic journals.

  • Outreach & Consulting: Building industry relationships and contributing to consulting initiatives.

  • Institutional Leadership: Supporting academic administration, programme development, and institutional growth.

Research Publication Criteria

The advertisement identifies the following journal classifications:

FT50 / UTD24

Tier 2

ABDC A* / ABS 4*, 4

Tier 3

ABDC A / ABS 3

Applicants should ensure their research publications satisfy the applicable criteria for their respective academic positions.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through email using the following details.

For Faculty Recruitment:

Send your detailed CV to:

Email: facultyrecruit@imi.edu

Application Form: CLICK HERE

Email: career@imibh.edu.in

Candidates should provide accurate academic qualifications, teaching and research experience, publication records, and other relevant professional information.

Official Website: https://imibh.edu.in

Applicants are advised to consult the official website for recruitment updates and further instructions.

Job Domain: Business & Management / Management Education / Faculty Recruitment

Job Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India

jobs.title: IIT Guwahati JRF Recruitment 2026 – Junior Research Fellow (GATE) Position in Climate Change Research

IIT Guwahati JRF Recruitment 2026 – Junior Research Fellow (GATE) Position in Climate Change Research

The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati invites applications for Junior Research Fellow (JRF-GATE) under a research project at the School of Interdisciplinary Studies and Sustainability.

The project, titled “Futuristic Risk Assessment of Temperature-Humidity Extremes Due to Climate Change on Human Well-Being and Energy Demand in the Indian Sub-Continent,” focuses on climate change, temperature-humidity extremes, human well-being, and energy demand.

Eligible candidates can apply for the position offering a total monthly remuneration of INR 42,920, including HRA.

Application Deadline: 2 November 2026

Details

Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati

About the Research Project

The School of Interdisciplinary Studies and Sustainability at IIT Guwahati is recruiting a Junior Research Fellow for a project examining the effects of climate change and extreme temperature-humidity conditions in the Indian subcontinent.

The research focuses on understanding the relationship between climatic extremes, human well-being, and energy demand.

Key research themes include:

  • Climate change and temperature-humidity extremes.

  • Climate-related risks to human well-being.

  • Energy demand under changing climatic conditions.

  • Future climate-risk assessment in the Indian subcontinent.

  • Interdisciplinary sustainability research.

The opportunity is relevant to candidates interested in climate science, environmental research, engineering, and sustainability.

Essential Qualifications

Candidates must possess a Graduate or Postgraduate Degree in a professional course, such as:

  • Water Resources Engineering

  • Energy Engineering

  • Electrical Engineering

The qualification must be obtained through a recognised selection process prescribed in the recruitment advertisement.

The visible notification specifies the following qualifying routes:

  1. Selection through GATE or national eligibility examinations such as CSIR-UGC NET, including lectureship (Assistant Professorship).

  2. Selection through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government departments and their agencies.

Candidates should consult the complete official advertisement for the remaining eligibility details and any additional qualifying disciplines.

Fellowship and Remuneration

The fellowship and allowances are subject to the applicable project and institute rules.

Appointment Duration

Duration: 11 Months

The position is associated with the specified research project at IIT Guwahati.

The supplied advertisement does not specify whether the appointment may be extended.

Selection Process

The selection process will be conducted through an online interview.

Interview Details:

  • Date: 4 November 2026 (Wednesday)

  • Time: 10:00 AM

  • Mode: Online

  • Interview Link: Will be shared with eligible candidates one day before the interview.

Candidates should ensure that their contact details are accurate and monitor communications regarding interview eligibility and participation.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should follow the application instructions provided in the official IIT Guwahati recruitment notification.

  1. Review the eligibility criteria for the JRF-GATE position.

  2. Refer to the complete advertisement for the prescribed application procedure.

  3. Submit the application before 2 November 2026.

  4. Eligible candidates should attend the online interview on 4 November 2026 at 10:00 AM, using the link shared by the institute.
